config.prediction: If frozen L2H5 is mainly value-repetition sensitive, matching values yield more-negative native first→second-source edge coefficients even when keys differ. A binding-specific account predicts a key×value interaction beyond value matching. Raw residual similarity remains an alternative.
config.design: 16items×2formats×same/different keys×same/different values×two query choices; source-position alignment checked across all8cells per item/format. Fully native forward passes. Future query changes provide a causal invariance audit.
config.ambiguity: Same key with conflicting values has no assigned correct answer. Other cells use intended value and full-vocabulary accuracy; candidate contrast retained separately.
config.limitations: Small controlled panel; repeated key/value contrasts can correlate with activation similarity. Signed routing is not a probability or a causal mediation result. Query duplicates exist when keys match.
